description: Na₅LiMn₂P₂(CO₇)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.92 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.47 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.76 Å. Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.22 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.33 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.22 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.31 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. All P-O bond lengths are 1.56 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-57°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one C atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂LiC tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂MnP tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Li and one C atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom.
